description: Calculation using hybrid exchange-correlation functionals (HSE06, PBE0, etc.)

ALGO.note: MUST use All or Damped. Fast/VeryFast NOT supported.

ISMEAR.rule: 0 for semiconductors, 1 for metals (be careful with metals + hybrids)

hse06.note: Most popular hybrid for solids. Screened exchange makes it tractable.

pbe0.note: Unscreened, very expensive for large cells.

NKRED.rule: downsampling k-mesh for HF, reduces cost significantly

kpoints.rule: Gamma-centered, coarser than PBE is OK due to cost. Typically 4x4x4 to 6x6x6 for bulk.
kpoints.note: NKRED can reduce HF k-mesh further

workflow_notes: Start from PBE-relaxed structure (hybrid relaxation is expensive)
For band structure: use KPOINTS_OPT method (ICHARG=11 does NOT work for hybrids)
Typical cost: 10-100x PBE for same system

band_structure_with_hybrid.note: KPOINTS = SCF mesh, KPOINTS_OPT = high-symmetry path
